notice: These official references are review guidance, not evidence that a specific entity is registered or that a specific claim is true.

sources.title: Recognised Intermediaries
sources.reviewPrompt: Verify the exact legal name and SEBI registration number in the official intermediary register. A number printed in an advertisement is not self-verifying.

sources.title: Advertisement Code for Investment Advisers and Research Analysts
sources.reviewPrompt: Check the claim against the applicable advertisement code, including restrictions around assured returns, risk-free language, performance references and misleading testimonials.

sources.title: Public caution on investment advisers and research analysts
sources.reviewPrompt: Check registration status and inspect whether tips, recommendations or unrealistic-return messages are being distributed through public or direct-message channels.

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
sources.reviewPrompt: Confirm the regulated entity or lending-service-provider relationship and review APR, Key Fact Statement, consent, data minimisation and grievance disclosures.

sources.title: Public repository of Digital Lending Apps
sources.reviewPrompt: Verify any claimed association between a loan app and an RBI-regulated entity. The directory is based on entity-submitted information and still requires human review.

sources.title: View Company / LLP Master Data
sources.reviewPrompt: Verify the company or LLP legal name and status using MCA master data. MCA incorporation is not equivalent to SEBI or RBI authorisation.
